doesNotAuthorize: consumer-domain identity, authorization, role, grant, policy, principal, environment, deployment, release, or workspace semantics
comprehensive Docker Compose modeling or a Program Kit container orchestrator
automatic Aspire, container, Dev Container, Keycloak, Azure, deployment, or infrastructure execution
production Keycloak provisioning, backup, migration, or administration
a custom general-purpose OpenAPI client generator
opaque-token introspection, dynamic client registration, provider discovery, or automatic issuer selection
device authorization, CIBA, FAPI, DPoP, implicit flow, resource-owner-password flow, or generic JavaScript generation
automatic real-provider login, credential capture, bypass of MFA, passkeys, consent, conditional access, CAPTCHA, or another provider-controlled human interaction
application or consumer-domain observability meaning, a business-event or security-audit ledger, compliance evidence, telemetry backend, collector, dashboard, alert, retention, or incident policy
automatic telemetry emission from Program Kit generation, validation, design, or development-session tools
a base semantic dependency on Serilog, NLog, Application Insights, Seq, Grafana, Prometheus, or another vendor product
Program Kit ownership of external configuration meaning, defaults, business validation, compatibility, or runtime reaction semantics
a universal interpolated secret string, centralized Program Kit secret provider, store or broker, live-configuration control plane, or generic remote configuration-editing endpoint
coercion of every protected capability into IConfiguration, disclosure of classified secret locators, or silent merging of generated bases and human/provider-owned overlays
a universal guarantee of atomic, zero-downtime, rollback-capable, cross-process, or last-known-good secret rotation
credentials, network discovery, cloud mutation, deployment, publication, or release activity
